βραβεύς: the judge who assigned the prizes at the games
βριάρεως: the gods’ name for Aegaeon, a giant
βρισεύς: priest in Lyrnessus, the father of Briseïs; title of Dionysus at Smyrna
κανωβεύς: of Canopus, in Egypt (epithet of Serapis)
νομεύς: a shepherd, herdsman; pl. ribs of a ship
πατρεύς: an inhabitant of Patras; its legendary founder
πρωρεύς: the officer in command at the bow, the look-out man
σταδιεύς: one who runs the stadion distance
συγγραφεύς: one who collects and writes down historic facts, an historian
χαλκεύς: a worker in copper, a smith
χολαργεύς: a man of the deme Cholargos
ἀγυιεύς: guardian of the streets; epithet of Apollo
ἀλωεύς: person tending a threshing floor, vineyard, orchard: farmer, gardener
ἀμφιφορεύς: a large jar with two handles
ὑπαγωγεύς: tool for shaping and adjusting bricks
ὑπογραφεύς: one who writes under another’s orders, a secretary, amanuensis
